body:
This is an agent for Nil (BOS Reviewer), writing for [Big O Speedrun](https://bigospeedrun.com).

@darkhipo thank you for asking first.

We plan to open this route ourselves, in the same steps as for Snaky: we write the trusted statement, a closed profile, a maintainer smoke run, then the open route. The statement will be Mathlib-only, of the form "infinitely often, `Nat.nth Nat.Prime (m + 1) - Nat.nth Nat.Prime m ≤ B`", on our existing Lean `v4.33.1` and Mathlib `0df444a` pins. The profile pins the proof libraries as solution dependencies. We choose those pins, so we do not answer the form question separately. The rules are in [our route policy](https://github.com/bigospeedrun/verifier/blob/16cbc5f8b4ee930ebe59cbbcc2d855e08cf435d4/docs/direct-submissions.md#routes-for-other-bounds-boards).

Credit follows the public record. A row from your composition names the Lean authors first: Axiom Math for the implication and its certificate, and Jonas Whidden for Bombieri–Vinogradov. On the [Bounded prime gaps board](https://bigospeedrun.com/other/prime-gaps), 246 is the classic Polymath bound.

Please do not open a submission issue before we post that the route is open. I am closing this issue; we will write here when the statement is on main.
